item.title: How elite military leadership principles strengthen industrial teams
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger speaks with retired United States Navy SEAL Rob O’Neill about leadership, preparation and decision-making under pressure.

item.title: EIA raises natural gas price forecast following increased heating demand amid severe winter weather
item.description: Natural gas prices rose sharply in January, averaging $7.72 per million British thermal units (MMBtu), as cold weather increased heating demand, reduced production, and led to record storage withdrawals during Winter Storm Fern.

item.title: Podcast: Safety 4.0: Digital transformation, predictive analytics & life-saving technologies
item.description: In this podcast, Russell Klinegardner leads a discussion with industry safety leaders on how AI, predictive analytics and digital tools are reshaping safety operations in real time.

item.title: Citgo struggles with long-term direction as sale process remains frozen
item.description: The department's Office of Foreign Assets Control in early February extended its long-standing protection from creditors for Citgo through March 20.

item.title: ECC Extra 2026
item.description: Energy and industrial leaders connect in Birmingham, Alabama for ECC Extra and the ECC Opening Reception, networking and sharing insights across refining, petrochemical and industrial services sectors.

item.title: Fueling hope for four decades: CITGO and MDA’s enduring partnership
item.description: Corporate and social responsibility can sometimes feel like a buzzword. The partnership between CITGO Petroleum Corp. and the Muscular Dystrophy Association (MDA), however, stands out as a testament to what sustained commitment can achieve.

item.title: Alva Energy launches with $33 million to unlock 10 GWe of nuclear power
item.description: The company’s solution can deliver usable clean energy at scale from existing plants far faster and at much lower cost than new nuclear plants can be built – on a timeline and cost that is competitive with gas-fired generation.

item.title: Libya awards new oil, gas blocks to Chevron, Eni, others in first bidding round since 2007
item.description: The National Oil Corporation announced the winners of its first bidding round since 2007, allocating key acreage across the onshore Sirte and Murzuq basins and the offshore Sirte basin in the gas-rich Mediterranean.

item.title: Rain for Rent appoints Elliot Zimmer as Chief Executive Officer
item.description: On behalf of the Board of Directors and Company Shareholders, Rain for Rent announced Elliot Zimmer as Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Paul Harrington.

item.title: President Trump and Administrator Zeldin deliver the single largest deregulatory action in U.S. history
item.description: EPA's final rule saves taxpayers $1.3T by nixing the 2009 GHG Endangerment Finding and all federal GHG emission standards for vehicles and engines from MY 2012 through 2027 and beyond.
